versions.content: The TcpIp module shall indicate events related to sockets to the upper layer module by using the Up _TcpIpEvent API and the follo wing events: TCPIP_TCP_RESET, TCPIP_TCP_CLOSED, TCPIP_TCP_FIN_RECEIVED and TCPIP_UDP_CLOSED .
